abstract: Reference values for postnatal serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and concanavalin A (ConA) binding subfractions of AFP in preterm and term infants are presented. Preterm infants had 10-fold higher serum concentrations of AFP than did term infants at birth. The reduction of serum values of AFP was biphasic in both groups and differed significantly between the two groups. The first declining phase continued for approximately 4 months in preterm and for 2 months in term infants, and was related to the degree of prematurity. The AFP values reached adult levels by 12 months in preterm and by 9 months in term infants. The developmental pattern of the carbohydrate moiety of AFP was determined by ConA fractioning. The proportion of the ConA nonreactive subfraction of AFP in preterm and term infants at birth was 6% and 13%, respectively; it increased more rapidly in term than in preterm infants but reached 85% to 95% by the age of 6 months in both infant groups. Our results indicate that the postnatal maturation of AFP synthesis is dependent on gestational age. Malignant recurrences of neonatal sacrococcygeal teratomas were associated with an increase in serum concentration of AFP and a decrease in the proportion of the ConA nonreactive subfraction of AFP.
abstract_ja: 早産児および正期産児における出生後の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とそのコンカナバリンA(ConA)結合分画の基準値を示した。出生時、早産児の血清AFP濃度は正期産児より10倍高かった。AFPの低下は両群で二相性を示し、群間で有意に異なった。最初の低下相は早産児で約4か月、正期産児で2か月続き、早産の程度に関連していた。AFP値は早産児では12か月、正期産児では9か月で成人値に達した。AFP糖鎖の発達パターンはConA分画により評価した。出生時のConA非反応分画の割合は、早産児で6%、正期産児で13%であった。この割合は正期産児で急速に増加し、両群とも生後6か月までに85〜95%に達した。以上より、AFP合成の出生後の成熟は在胎週数に依存することが示された。新生児仙尾部奇形腫の悪性再発は、血清AFP濃度の上昇とAFPのConA非反応分画の低下に関連していた。
